title: Video To Workspace
text: Export image or video to MATLAB workspace, 4 inputs; {Variable name} sets the mATLAB workspace variable, {Number of inputs}, {Limit data points to last} sets the maximum number of frames to export, {Decimation} sets the downsample video signal, {Log fixed-point data as a fi object} sets the create fixed-point numeric object and {Input port labels} sets the input port names R. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: R
ports.summary: Red color channel scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: G
ports.summary: Green color channel scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: B
ports.summary: Blue color channel scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Variable name
params.values: MATLAB workspace variable name vout (default) | valid MATLAB variable name

params.name: Number of inputs
params.values: Number of inputs ports 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Limit data points to last
params.values: Maximum number of frames to export 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Log fixed-point data as a fi object
params.values: Create fixed-point numeric object off (default) | on
